description: Which side of the perp market is over-leveraged right now, and how exposed it is — not a raw feed. Composes Hyperliquid funding, premium and open interest with OKX open interest and the long/short account ratio into a named regime (LONG_SQUEEZE_RISK / SHORT_SQUEEZE_RISK / BALANCED), a 0-100 pressure score, and the evidence behind it. The pre-position read for a leveraged agent. Free public upstreams, no exchange key.
name: get_crypto_liquidations
